game_concept: A survival strategy set in The Kingdom – Watchtower Ring, towers along the town wall: the herald must handle bandits while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Rename Rush: Pick valid variable names (no spaces, no leading digits) to unlock doors across the area.
theme: The Kingdom – Watchtower Ring: towers along the town wall
core_gameplay_loop: Read the requested procedure, drag flowchart shapes into the chart, then run checks against example inputs and expected outputs.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the town gate from bandits in Watchtower Ring: keep the valid_names meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 41-second timer ends.
controls: Drag blocks from the tray into chart positions. Drag them back to remove them. Check chart runs the algorithm. Keyboard: [ or ] selects a block, arrows choose a position, Enter places, C checks, Escape pauses.
lose_condition: valid_names drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 41-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: CP1 Week 1: Controls and mission practice
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Rename Rush' (Week 1 slot 11), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Watchtower Ring'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how valid_names changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against bandits in Watchtower Ring.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 41 seconds while valid_names > 0.
